components.name: Structural Grid and Section Index
components.description: A non-semantic guide layer aligns the sticky rail, numeric section indices, headings, and reading measure without enclosing content in cards.
components.html:
01

Section content
components.css: .ds-frame { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(15,minmax(0,1fr)); width:min(100%,1440px); margin:0 auto; padding:0 64px; } .ds-guides { position:absolute; inset:0 64px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(15,minmax(0,1fr)); pointer-events:none; } .ds-guide { position:relative; grid-row:1; min-height:100%; } .ds-guide::before { position:absolute; inset-block:0; left:-.5px; width:1px; background:var(--rule,rgba(0,0,0,.06)); content:''; } .ds-guide-start { grid-column:1; } .ds-guide-rail { grid-column:4; } .ds-guide-reading { grid-column:5; } .ds-guide-measure { grid-column:13; } .ds-guide-end { grid-column:15; } .ds-indexed-section { display:grid; grid-column:4/-1; grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr)); } .ds-section-index { grid-column:1; color:var(--muted,#70706c); font:10px/1.5 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-indexed-section h2 { grid-column:2/span 7; margin:0; font:400 36px/1.1 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.02em; } @media (max-width:767px) { .ds-guides,.ds-section-index { display:none; } .ds-frame,.ds-indexed-section { display:block; padding-inline:20px; } }

components.name: Active Rail Link
components.description: Plain text navigation with a narrow blue state rule.
components.css: .ds-rail-link { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 27px; align-items: center; padding-left: 13px; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); font: 15px/1.3 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-rail-link::before { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; width: 2px; height: 12px; background: currentColor; content: ''; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-50%) scaleY(.4); transform-origin: center; transition: opacity 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-rail-link.is-active { color: var(--accent, #2200ff); } .ds-rail-link.is-active::before { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-50%) scaleY(1); } .ds-rail-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2200ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-rail-link:active { transform: scale(.97); } @media (pointer:coarse) { .ds-rail-link { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Mobile Menu Control
components.description: Literal text control with no pill, icon, or shadow.
components.css: .ds-menu-control { display: inline-flex; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); background: transparent; font: 15px/1 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-menu-control:hover { color: var(--accent, #2200ff); } .ds-menu-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2200ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-menu-control:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Domain Directory Row
components.description: Number, title, and arrow aligned by a single structural rule.
components.css: .ds-domain-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0,1fr) 32px; min-height: 84px; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(0,0,0,.06)); color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); font: 15px/1.3 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; gap: 16px; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-domain-row strong { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -.015em; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-domain-row span:last-child { justify-self: end; font-size: 18px; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-domain-row:hover { color: var(--accent, #2200ff); border-color: var(--rule-strong, rgba(0,0,0,.24)); } .ds-domain-row:hover span:last-child { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-domain-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2200ff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Monochrome LO Wordmark
components.description: The shared geometric LO master paired with Theodore's name in the navigation rail.
components.html: Theodore Ouyang
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-wordmark-lockup { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; transition: opacity 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-wordmark-mark { display: block; width: 18px; height: 11.25px; flex: 0 0 18px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-wordmark-name { font: 400 13px/1 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.012em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-wordmark:hover .ds-wordmark-lockup { opacity: .68; transform: translateX(1px); } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2200ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-wordmark:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Experience Metadata
components.description: Single-column metadata stack with quiet labels and a fixed label measure.
components.css: .ds-entry-metadata { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: 720px; margin: 38px 0 0; padding: 22px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(0,0,0,.06)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(0,0,0,.06)); gap: 13px; } .ds-entry-metadata > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; } .ds-entry-metadata dt, .ds-entry-metadata dd { margin: 0; } .ds-entry-metadata dt { color: var(--muted, #70706c); font: 12px/1.4 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-entry-metadata dd { color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); font: 15px/1.5 Georgia, serif; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Experience Project and Bullets
components.description: Restrained project context followed by visibly marked narrative evidence.
components.html:
Project

Practical AI evaluation

  • Translated ambiguous requirements into clear evaluation criteria.
  • Validated decisions against real-world use cases.
components.css: .ds-entry-project { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0,1fr); max-width: 720px; margin: 28px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #70706c); font: 13px/1.5 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; gap: 16px; } .ds-entry-project span { font-size: 12px; } .ds-entry-project p { margin: 0; } .ds-archive-bullets { display: grid; max-width: 72ch; margin: 30px 0 0; padding-left: 18px; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); font: 15px/1.5 Georgia, serif; list-style: disc; gap: 15px; } .ds-archive-bullets li { padding-left: 7px; } .ds-archive-bullets li::marker { color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); font-size: .72em; }

components.name: Coordinates Matrix
components.description: A content-weighted contact matrix that protects long identifiers before changing density.
components.css: .ds-coordinates { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(148px,1.2fr) minmax(0,.72fr); margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, rgba(0,0,0,.24)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, rgba(0,0,0,.24)); list-style: none; } .ds-coordinates li { display: grid; align-content: start; min-width: 0; min-height: 118px; padding: 25px 19px 29px; gap: 20px; } .ds-coordinates li:first-child { padding-left: 0; } .ds-coordinates li + li { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(0,0,0,.06)); } .ds-coordinates span { color: var(--muted, #70706c); font: 11px/1.3 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-coordinates strong, .ds-coordinates a { color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); font: 400 14px/1.4 Georgia, serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-coordinates a { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; min-height: 24px; align-items: center; text-decoration-color: var(--rule-strong, rgba(0,0,0,.24)); text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-coordinates a:hover { color: var(--accent, #2200ff); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-coordinates a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2200ff); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (pointer:coarse) { .ds-coordinates a { min-height: 44px; } } @media (max-width:1279.98px) { .ds-coordinates { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); } .ds-coordinates li:nth-child(3) { padding-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(0,0,0,.06)); border-left: 0; } .ds-coordinates li:nth-child(4) { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(0,0,0,.06)); } } @media (max-width:540px) { .ds-coordinates { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-coordinates li, .ds-coordinates li:first-child { min-height: 92px; padding: 20px 0 23px; } .ds-coordinates li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(0,0,0,.06)); border-left: 0; } }

components.name: Dithered Entrance
components.description: Static sidecar representation of the Home-only Canvas2D identity entrance and approved compact Scroll cue.
components.html:
THEODOREOUYANG
Scroll
components.css: .ds-dither-entrance { position: relative; display: grid; min-height: 100vh; place-items: center; background: var(--page,#f7f6f5); } .ds-dither-stage { display: grid; width: min(76vw,72dvh,720px); aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; color: var(--dither,#070707); container-type: inline-size; } .ds-dither-name { display: grid; width: 90%; align-content: center; font-family: Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; font-weight: 800; line-height: .84; text-align: center; } .ds-dither-name span:first-child { font-size: 17cqw; } .ds-dither-name span:last-child { font-size: 23.5cqw; } .ds-scroll-cue { position: absolute; bottom: 30px; left: 50%; min-height: 44px; color: var(--muted,#70706c); font: 600 11px/1 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: translateX(-50%); } @supports ((-webkit-background-clip:text) or (background-clip:text)) { .ds-dither-name span { color: transparent; background-image: radial-gradient(circle,var(--dither,#070707) 0 .7px,transparent .85px); background-size: 2px 2px; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; } } @media (max-width:767px) { .ds-dither-stage { width: min(92vw,68dvh,380px); } .ds-scroll-cue { bottom: 22px; } }

narrative.overview: The site pairs a single expressive opening gesture with a disciplined editorial body. The Home-only dithered name establishes authorship; everything after it earns trust through warm paper, exact grid alignment, serif reading texture, and very limited color. The system should feel mature enough for an AI researcher or operator while remaining unmistakably personal.
keyCharacteristics: One high-expression entrance, followed by quiet reading surfaces.
Cognition-like structural discipline implemented with Theodore's own content and mark.
Warm white, near-black, hairline rules, and rare signal blue.
No decorative modules that compete with the writing.

rules.name: The Rare Blue Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue identifies state; it never becomes a large background fill.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sans establishes structure; serif carries narrative. Do not introduce a third personality font.

rules.name: The Flat Authority Rule
rules.body: If an element needs a shadow to appear important, its hierarchy is wrong.

dos: Do preserve protected biographical sources, factual claims, routes, metadata, alt text, ARIA labels, and content order unless Theodore explicitly approves a revision.
Do use whitespace and real content boundaries before adding any new visual element.
Do keep the entrance interaction interruptible, idle-aware, and fully static under reduced motion.
Do preserve 44px targets for coarse-pointer navigation and standalone links.
Do keep section indices in their dedicated grid track and true headings in the reading track.
Do verify 1440px, 1024px, 768px, 540px, 430px, 390px, and 320px layouts before release.
donts: Don't add a global WebGL background, handwritten interface typography, glass navigation, or ambient decorative motion.
Don't add pill navigation, bento cards, scroll reveals, parallax, or GSAP storytelling.
Don't copy Cognition's logo, client material, CSS, font files, or source code.
Don't add new decorative interface copy, scroll prompts, or pseudo-technical glyphs beyond the approved visible-copy baseline.
